children: Azerbaijan’s economy grew 1.2% year-on-year in January-August 2026, slowing from a 1.4% expansion in the first seven months of the year.
The non-oil and gas sector contracted further (-0.8% vs -0.6% in the January-July), while growth in the non-oil and gas sector eased slightly (2.1% vs 2.2%).
Industrial output fell 0.4%, reversing a 0.3% increase.

Meanwhile, growth moderated in agricultural output (2.6% vs 2.8%), while output in transportation and warehousing services (8.7% vs 7.1%), information and communication services (10.7% vs. 10.4%), and retail trade turnover (3.9% vs 3.8%) continued to rise.

title: Azerbaijan Economy Grows 1.2% in January-August
